approval_evidence.quote: Approval Date(s) and History, Letters, Labels, Reviews for NDA 022128 ... 08/06/2007 ORIG-1 Approval Type 1 - New Molecular Entity PRIORITY; SELZENTRY TABLET;ORAL

series_start_reason: Series starts at 2010Q1, the first quarter of the ViiV Healthcare era in GSK's quarterly releases. The original owner marketed Selzentry before ViiV was formed (Nov 2009); GSK releases of 2008-2009 and the Q4 2009 release (6-K 2010-02-04) print no Selzentry row, and no prior-owner quarterly figures were located.
series_end_reason: From the Q1 2021 release (6-K 2021-04-28) the HIV section lists Dolutegravir products, Rukobia, Cabenuva and 'Other' only; Selzentry and Epzicom/Kivexa are no longer separate rows. The Q4 2020 release (6-K 2021-02-03) is the last that prints Selzentry.
notes: Worldwide GSK (ViiV Healthcare) turnover for Selzentry in GBP millions, taken from the 'Pharmaceuticals turnover' regional tables (Total column). ViiV Healthcare was formed on 1 November 2009; the product is sold as Selzentry in the U.S. and Celsentri elsewhere, but GSK prints the single label 'Selzentry'. FDA approval 2007-08-06. launch_quarter is null: no cited document dates the launch.
search_log: fetched data.sec.gov submissions CIK0001131399 (GSK plc) recent + history pages; selected 6-K / 6-K/A filings whose primaryDocDescription is a quarterly/half-year/final results announcement (plus 2010-2012 6-Ks matching RESULT/TURNOVER/FORM 6-K/QUARTER/HALF); downloaded each and converted tables to text

per release: product row located by exact row label in the 'Pharmaceuticals turnover' regional table (Total column = worldwide) or, where the product is absent from it, in the 'Sales from New Pharmaceutical and Vaccine products' table; Q1 taken from the Q1 release, Q2/Q3 from the 3-month column of the Q2/Q3 release, Q4 from the 3-month column of the Q4/full-year release (the same release prints the full-year row)
cross-check: Q1+Q2+Q3+Q4 equals the full-year row printed in the Q4 release for every complete year, and Q1+Q2 / +Q3 equal the printed six-/nine-month rows
FDA approval: fetched the Drugs@FDA overview page for the NDA
checked GSK releases 2008-02-07 to 2010-02-04 (docs2 set) for a Selzentry/Celsentri row: none

prior owner fallback: one Bigdata.com smart search for Pfizer Selzentry 2008 product revenues returned no documents; Pfizer filings were not otherwise read, so any 2007-2009 prior-owner figures are unverified and not included
2021-2026 releases: no Selzentry row (HIV section shows 'Other')
